title: Aligned Machine: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Embedding Similarity via Human Comparative Judgements
abstract: arXiv:2611.33594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embedding models increasingly inform how people search, recommend, and retrieve information, yet we lack credible ways to test whether these similarity judgments reflect how humans understand meaning. Existing benchmarks typically rely on static, expert-labeled pairs with coarse Likert-style annotations, limiting scalability and making it difficult to obtain consistent, high-confidence annotations. We introduce Aligned Machine, an interactive, public-facing platform that transforms broad participation into a continuously growing Human-Aligned Similarity Benchmark (HASB) for evaluating semantic alignment in embedding-based systems. Participants complete a cognitively-natural, forced-choice task, comparing two pairs of items (text or images) and selecting which pair is more similar. This comparative design is accessible to non-experts, yields clean preference data, and supports robust aggregation. We report results from an initial deployme

translated_title: 对齐机器：基于人类比较判断的多模态嵌入相似性评估基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33594v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：嵌入模型日益影响着人们搜索、推荐和检索信息的方式，然而我们缺乏可靠的方法来检验这些相似性判断是否反映了人类对意义的理解。现有基准通常依赖于静态的、由专家标注的配对数据，并采用粗糙的李克特量表式标注，这限制了可扩展性，也难以获得一致且高置信度的标注。我们提出了“对齐机器”，这是一个交互式、面向公众的平台，它将广泛的公众参与转化为一个持续增长的“人类对齐相似性基准”（HASB），用于评估基于嵌入的系统的语义对齐能力。参与者完成一个认知上自然的强制选择任务：比较两对条目（文本或图像），并选出更相似的一对。这种比较式设计对非专家用户十分友好，能产生干净的偏好数据，并支持稳健的聚合分析。我们报告了首次部署的结果……
tldr: 该论文提出“对齐机器”这一交互式公众平台，通过让大众完成两两比较的强制选择任务，构建了可持续增长的人类对齐相似性基准（HASB），以评估嵌入模型的语义对齐能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Aligned Machine, an interactive public platform that transforms broad human participation into a continuously growing Human-Aligned Similarity Benchmark (HASB), evaluating semantic alignment of embedding models via a natural forced-choice comparative task.
